value.rationale: For natural block-permuton search trees, the theorem identifies a topology-dependent full second-order law and a sharp dichotomy for positive sqrt(log n) mean excess. Balanced three-block trees have a non-Gaussian max law and coefficient 1/sqrt(pi), whereas skew trees have N(0,2) and no such correction. This quantifies a substantive search-complexity effect absent from first-order results.
